resources.text: Salivary amylase begins digestion of starch in the mouth. The tongue helps swallow food.
Peristalsis is the muscular wave that pushes food through the oesophagus toward the stomach.
The small intestine absorbs digested nutrients into the blood through villi.
Illustration: stomach, liver, pancreas and small intestine in the human digestive system.
The large intestine absorbs water and helps form faeces.
